visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a colorful hair extension, wearing a white tank top and tight red shorts, walks toward a wooden door with a black sign that reads '喜 板前燒肉'. He enters the establishment. (2) Inside at the reception, the man leans casually on the counter, talking to a female staff member who is using a tablet. The setting is a dimly lit, high-end restaurant with warm indoor lighting. (3) A montage shows the man kneeling on the floor in a dark hallway, looking up with a sorrowful expression while a staff member stands nearby with arms crossed. (4) In a dining area, a group of friends stands behind the man, holding lit sparklers. On the counter is a large golden egg. The man picks up a peach-shaped bun and eats it with a neutral face. (5) A male chef in a black uniform approaches the man at the counter. The man gestures with tongs and a knife, appearing to decline help. (6) The man uses tongs to flip a piece of meat on a built-in grill; the meat appears charred and black. He puts it in his mouth and immediately reacts with a shocked, gagging expression, spitting out smoke. (7) A large platter of marbled raw beef is placed before him. Instead of looking at the food, the man stares intensely at his smartphone, ignoring the meal. (8) The man sits at the counter next to a woman. A small pudding dessert is served to her. He reaches over with a spoon, takes a large bite of her dessert, and stares at her. She looks bewildered and walks away, leaving him staring directly into the camera lens with a defiant look.
